purpose: Questions of this release that descend from a collection of 166 STACK questions for the courses Höhere Mathematik 1 and 2 of the project SKATING at Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik und Wirtschaft (Karlsruhe University of Applied Sciences), cited here as "STACK questions for Höhere Mathematik 1 and 2" (below: the Karlsruhe collection). The credit of each question of a contributed bank (question_author_credit in the source table) names its collection question, the Karlsruhe collection, the licence with its address and whether and how the question was changed; the credit of each descendant in the TH Köln pool names the pool's authors and then its collection question.

licence: The Karlsruhe collection is licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 DE (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/de/). We treat a question as an adaptation of its collection question when it differs from it in wording, question variables, inputs or the logic of a response tree (169 questions). An adaptation is released under CC BY-SA 4.0, which section 4b of CC BY-SA 3.0 DE allows; the material taken from the Karlsruhe collection remains under CC BY-SA 3.0 DE. A question that equals its collection question in every field (11), or differs from it only in the typesetting of formulas or in penalty settings (10), is not treated as an adaptation and keeps CC BY-SA 3.0 DE. content_license is CC-BY-SA-3.0-DE for a question that keeps CC BY-SA 3.0 DE and CC-BY-SA-4.0 for an adaptation, which is released as part of this dataset. Worked solutions are under CC BY-SA 4.0 and carry their own credit (gf_attribution_text), also where the question itself keeps CC BY-SA 3.0 DE; a worked solution that was added to a question later (worked_solution_added) is not part of the collection question. For 9 descendants the collection question has a worked solution of its own (8 in English, 1 in German), marked by collection_question_has_worked_solution; the released worked solutions of these questions are German texts written by their credited author.
not_an_endorsement: Naming the source does not imply that Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik und Wirtschaft or the project SKATING endorse, sponsor or are otherwise connected with this dataset.

note: bank is the code of the source bank as released. relation is changed (an adaptation: changed in wording, question variables, inputs or the logic of a response tree), changed_in_typesetting_or_penalties_only or unchanged (taken over unchanged). A question counts as taken over unchanged when every field of it equals that of its collection question (question text, question variables, inputs, response trees with their scores, penalties and feedback texts, question note, specific feedback, default grade, deployed seeds and question tests), apart from the name of the question, white space and HTML markup, the notation of variables in text that later versions of STACK write with braces, and fields that later versions of STACK add when a question is imported, with their default values; a worked solution added later does not count as a change. A question counts as changed in typesetting or penalty settings only when a comparison of every field (the same fields) shows differences in nothing but the typesetting of formulas (white space, spacing commands, displayed instead of inline formulas or the reverse, the limits and display-style commands, an upright d, the place of a punctuation mark) and penalty settings (the penalty of the question and the penalties of the nodes of its response trees). worked_solution_added is true where the question has a worked solution that the collection question does not have; collection_question_has_worked_solution is true where the question has a worked solution and the collection question has one of its own. The Karlsruhe collection itself is not part of this release.
